en.headline: Jazz quartet Aziza with Dave Holland performs at City Hall tonight
en.dek: The supergroup of Holland, Chris Potter, Lionel Loueke and Eric Harland marks the 10th anniversary of its album with an 8pm concert at Hong Kong City Hall Concert Hall.
body: Jazz supergroup Aziza will perform at Hong Kong City Hall Concert Hall at 8pm on Tuesday, featuring bassist Dave Holland, saxophonist Chris Potter, guitarist Lionel Loueke and drummer Eric Harland.

The concert marks the 10th anniversary of the group's self-titled album. Holland, a former member of Miles Davis's band and a three-time Grammy winner, leads the quartet. Organisers said the musicians are known for their improvisational interplay.

Tickets range from HK$380 to HK$1,080 and were sold through art-mate. The event is presented by Count-in Music Ltd with Jazz World (HK) Ltd. Recommended for ages 6 and above, with latecomers admitted only at suitable breaks.
The performance is one of several music events scheduled in Hong Kong this week, following the main draw opening of the Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open at Victoria Park.

zh.headline: 爵士超級組合Aziza今晚香港大會堂演出 Dave Holland領軍
zh.dek: 由Dave Holland、Chris Potter、Lionel Loueke及Eric Harland組成的四重奏，將於晚上8時在香港大會堂音樂廳演出，紀念專輯十周年。
body: 爵士樂超級組合Aziza今晚將於香港大會堂音樂廳演出，由貝斯手Dave Holland、色士風手Chris Potter、結他手Lionel Loueke及鼓手Eric Harland組成。
是次演出紀念組合同名專輯十周年。Holland曾為Miles Davis樂隊成員，並多次獲格萊美獎，領軍該四重奏。主辦單位指，四位樂手以即興互動見稱。
門票售價由380元至1080元，早前經art-mate發售。活動由起樂有限公司主辦，爵士世界（香港）有限公司協辦。建議六歲或以上觀眾欣賞，遲到者只會在合適間場獲准進場。
本周香港另有多項音樂活動，包括維多利亞公園保誠香港網球公開賽正賽已開打。
